description: This file contains utility functions related to socket address creation (Unix and UDP), byte stream printing, MAC address conversions, and byte manipulation for network communication. It includes functions for creating socket addresses, converting MAC addresses between string and array formats, converting integers to bytes and vice versa, and handling length-delimited buffers.

methods.name: void printByteStream(const std::vector<unsigned char> & byteStream)
methods.description: Prints the byte stream in hexadecimal format if DEBUG_MODE is defined.

methods.name: struct:sockaddr_un createUnixSocketAddress(const std::string & path)
methods.description: Creates and returns a Unix socket address structure with the given path.

methods.name: struct:sockaddr_in createUDPServerAddress(int port)
methods.description: Creates and returns a UDP server socket address structure bound to the specified port.

methods.name: struct:sockaddr_in createUDPClientAddress(const std::string & ip,int port)
methods.description: Creates and returns a UDP client socket address structure with the specified IP and port.

methods.name: std::string macAddressToString(const std::array<uint8_t,6> arr)
methods.description: Converts a MAC address array into a colon-separated string representation.

methods.name: bool areMacsEqual(const std::array<uint8_t,6> & first,const std::array<uint8_t,6> & second)
methods.description: Compares two MAC address arrays for equality.

methods.name: std::vector<unsigned char> convert_u32_into_bytes(uint32_t number)
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit unsigned integer into a vector of four bytes.

methods.name: uint32_t convert_bytes_into_u32(const std::vector<unsigned char> & bytes)
methods.description: Converts a vector of bytes into a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: std::vector<unsigned char> remove_length_delimited_part(const std::vector<unsigned char> & buffer)
methods.description: Removes the length prefix from a byte buffer, assuming it is a 4-byte length field.
